title: On Expecting a long silence after that
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：expect　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 expect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the operator ① expected a long silence after that in public, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② expects a long silence after that in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ expect a long silence after that at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ expected a long silence after that before — a line in the log for June 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Expecting a long silence after that in public, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ expect a letter every other week in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Expect a letter every other week at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ expects a letter every other week in public every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ expected a long silence after that again when nobody else would.

⑩ To expect a long silence after that, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody expects a long silence after that in silence again and somebody must expect a long silence after that in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 预料（一般过去式 expected a long silence after that：1981 年操作员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 预料（一般现在 expects a long silence after that：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 预料（不定式 to expect a long silence after that：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 预料（过去完成时 had expected a long silence after that：1975 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 预料（动名词 expecting a long silence after that 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 期待（expect a letter every other week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去期待隔周盼着一封信）
G. v. 期待（expect a letter every other week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 预料（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 expects a letter every other week，而母亲又一次 expected a long silence after that）

items.q: expected a long silence after that
expects a long silence after that

answers.why: expect 意为“预料”，1981 年操作员当着众人面预料料到那之后会长久沉默，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 expected。
expect 意为“预料”，自那以后操作员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 expects。
expect 意为“预料”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯预料料到那之后会长久沉默”，此处为不定式 to expect a long silence after that。
expect 意为“预料”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人预料过，故用过去完成时 had expected。
expect 意为“预料”，操作员说“预料料到那之后会长久沉默这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 expecting a long silence after that 作主语。
expect 意为“期待”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去期待隔周盼着一封信”，should ever 之后用原形 expect a letter every other week。
expect 意为“期待”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻期待隔周盼着一封信（expect a letter every other week at once），以后再也不要提起。
expect 意为“预料”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例期待隔周盼着一封信，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 expects。
expect 意为“预料”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面预料料到那之后会长久沉默，用一般过去式 expected 叙述。
expect 意为“预料”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要预料料到那之后会长久沉默，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1981 年，操作员当着众人面预料料到那之后会长久沉默；机房里每一个实习生都说这是头一回。（expected a long silence after that）
多年以后，操作员仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（expects a long silence after that）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯预料料到那之后会长久沉默这件事本身。（to expect a long silence after that）
早在 1975 年就有人预料料到那之后会长久沉默，六月那天运行日志上的一行字就是证据。（had expected a long silence after that）
操作员说过，当着众人面预料料到那之后会长久沉默这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（expecting a long silence after that 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻期待隔周盼着一封信，以后再也不要提起。（expect a letter every other week，祈使句）
answers: In 1981 the operator expected a long silence after that in public, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three shifts on, the operator still expects a long silence after that in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to expect a long silence after that at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had expected a long silence after that long before 1988, and the line in the log for June proves it.
Expecting a long silence after that in public, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 expect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the operator expected a long silence after that in public, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator expects a long silence after that in silence whenever the station asks.
Expecting a long silence after that in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever expect a letter every other week in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station expects a letter every other week in public every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother expected a long silence after that again, and the station remembered that half.
